authority: Non-authoritative P1 validator vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.source: Morphology v9.4 §5.10; P1.10.1 DG-1…DG-5, D-2, D-3
rules.implementation: dependency ending before target must be explained by object or subject retirement at the next phase, successor_ref, dropped or ends_reason; start gaps not covered
optional string; explains only scope_end|replaced_outside_plan|other with witness_ref; other values reported as gap
successor of a gap end shares subject and predicate and starts at the next phase
no gap for dangling, successor-missing, transition-conflict referents, invalid phases or undeclared successors
/1…/5 delegated to P1.10 byte-identically; /6 runs P1.10 on a lossless /5 projection
